title: Implement an in-process event bus in Go
description: Implement a simple in-process event bus that supports Subscribe, Publish, and Unsubscribe operations with string topic names.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the EventBus in eventbus.go:
- `New()` returns a pointer to an initialised EventBus with internal maps
- `Subscribe(topic, handler)` stores the handler and returns a unique integer ID
- `Unsubscribe(topic, id)` removes that subscription
- `Publish(topic, payload)` calls all registered handlers for that topic (no-op if none)
- Use a `sync.Mutex` to protect the handler map
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
